guideline: Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in every subject to be eligible for semester examinations.
Medical leave requires a valid certificate submitted within 3 days of rejoining.
Internal marks carry 40 marks and external examination carries 60 marks per subject.
A minimum of 40 total marks, with at least 21 in the external exam, is required to pass a subject.
Use of mobile phones or unfair means in the examination hall leads to disciplinary action.
Assignments must be submitted by the deadline; late submissions lose 10% marks per day.
Students must carry their ID card on campus at all times.
Ragging in any form is strictly prohibited and punishable as per law and college rules. Zero tolerance policy with 24/7 Helpline: 1800-180-5522.
Students should wear decent, formal attire; the department T-shirt is allowed on Fridays.
Students must follow lab safety rules and may not install unauthorised software on lab systems.
Lab records must be completed and signed by faculty before each practical session ends.
Books may be borrowed for 14 days; a fine of Rs. 2 per day applies for overdue books. Scan ID card upon entry.
Students must attend at least 80% of placement training sessions to be eligible for campus drives.
Grievances are submitted in writing to the department head and resolved within 7 working days.
